# fastText

[fastText](https://fasttext.cc/) is a library for efficient learning of word representations and sentence classification.

## What is fastText?

fastText is a library for efficient text classification and representation learning. It can be used for:

- **Word representation learning**: Learn vector representations of words (word embeddings)
- **Text classification**: Classify text documents into categories (e.g., spam detection, sentiment analysis)
- **Language identification**: Detect the language of text

## Usage

fastText provides a command-line tool with the following main commands:

### Word Representation Learning

Train word vectors using the skipgram model:
```bash
$ ./fasttext skipgram -input data.txt -output model
```

Train word vectors using the cbow model:
```bash
$ ./fasttext cbow -input data.txt -output model
```

### Getting Word Vectors

Print word vectors for words in a file:
```bash
$ ./fasttext print-word-vectors model.bin < queries.txt
```

Get word vectors for out-of-vocabulary words using subword information:
```bash
$ ./fasttext print-word-vectors model.bin
```

### Text Classification

Train a text classifier:
```bash
$ ./fasttext supervised -input train.txt -output model
```

Test the classifier:
```bash
$ ./fasttext test model.bin test.txt
```

Predict labels for new text:
```bash
$ ./fasttext predict model.bin test.txt
```

Predict labels with probabilities:
```bash
$ ./fasttext predict-prob model.bin test.txt
```

### Quantization

Reduce model size with quantization:
```bash
$ ./fasttext quantize -output model
```

This creates a `.ftz` file with reduced memory footprint while maintaining functionality.

## Input Format

### For Supervised Learning (Text Classification)

Training data should be in a text file with one sample per line. Each line should contain labels prefixed with `__label__` followed by the text:

```
__label__positive This movie was great!
__label__negative Terrible experience.
__label__neutral It was okay.
```

### For Unsupervised Learning (Word Vectors)

Training data should be a text file with one sentence per line:

```
This is a sample sentence.
Here is another sentence for training.
Word vectors will be learned from this text.
```

## Command-Line Options

Common options include:

**Dictionary options:**
- `-minCount`: Minimal number of word occurrences (default: 5 for word vectors, 1 for classification)
- `-wordNgrams`: Max length of word n-grams (default: 1)
- `-minn`: Min length of character n-gram (default: 0)
- `-maxn`: Max length of character n-gram (default: 0)
- `-bucket`: Number of buckets (default: 2000000)

**Training options:**
- `-lr`: Learning rate (default: 0.1 for supervised, 0.05 for word vectors)
- `-dim`: Size of word vectors (default: 100)
- `-ws`: Size of context window (default: 5)
- `-epoch`: Number of epochs (default: 5 for supervised, 5 for word vectors)
- `-neg`: Number of negatives sampled (default: 5)
- `-loss`: Loss function - ns (negative sampling), hs (hierarchical softmax), or softmax (default: softmax for supervised, ns for word vectors)
- `-thread`: Number of threads (default: 12)

**Quantization options:**
- `-cutoff`: Number of words and n-grams to retain (default: 0)
- `-retrain`: Whether to fine-tune embeddings if cutoff is applied (default: 0)
- `-qnorm`: Whether to quantize the norm separately (default: 0)
- `-qout`: Whether to quantize the classifier (default: 0)
- `-dsub`: Size of each sub-vector (default: 2)

Run any command without arguments to see its full option list:
```bash
$ ./fasttext supervised
$ ./fasttext skipgram
$ ./fasttext cbow
```

## Pre-trained Models

fastText provides pre-trained models:
- Word vectors for 157 languages trained on Wikipedia and Common Crawl
- English word vectors
- Language identification models
- Various supervised task models

Visit [https://fasttext.cc/](https://fasttext.cc/) for downloads and more information.

## Output Files

After training, fastText creates several files:

- `model.bin`: Full model file (can be used for further training or getting word vectors)
- `model.vec`: Text file containing word vectors (one per line)
- `model.ftz`: Quantized model file (smaller, load-only)

## Examples

### Example 1: Train Word Vectors

```bash
# Train skipgram model on text file
$ ./fasttext skipgram -input data.txt -output model -dim 300 -epoch 5

# Get vectors for specific words
$ echo "king queen man woman" | ./fasttext print-word-vectors model.bin
```

### Example 2: Text Classification

```bash
# Train classifier on labeled data
$ ./fasttext supervised -input train.txt -output model -epoch 25 -lr 1.0

# Test the model
$ ./fasttext test model.bin test.txt

# Predict on new data
$ ./fasttext predict model.bin -
> This is a test sentence
```

### Example 3: Quantization

```bash
# Quantize a model to reduce size
$ ./fasttext quantize -input model.bin -output model

# Use the quantized model (same as regular model)
$ ./fasttext test model.ftz test.txt
```

## Resources

- Website: [https://fasttext.cc/](https://fasttext.cc/)
- Documentation: [https://fasttext.cc/docs/](https://fasttext.cc/docs/)
- Pre-trained models: [https://fasttext.cc/docs/en/pretrained-vectors.html](https://fasttext.cc/docs/en/pretrained-vectors.html)
- Language identification: [https://fasttext.cc/docs/en/language-identification.html](https://fasttext.cc/docs/en/language-identification.html)

## Community

- Facebook group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/1174547215919768
- Google group: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/fasttext-library

## References

If you use fastText, please cite one of the following papers:

**For word representations:**
- P. Bojanowski, E. Grave, A. Joulin, T. Mikolov, "Enriching Word Vectors with Subword Information"

  quantize                quantize a model to reduce the memory usage
  test                    evaluate a supervised classifier
  test-label              print labels with precision and recall scores
  predict                 predict most likely labels

  print-word-vectors      print word vectors given a trained model
  print-sentence-vectors  print sentence vectors given a trained model
  print-ngrams            print ngrams given a trained model and word

def eprint(s: str = "", end: str = "\n") -> None:

def fmt_float(x: float) -> str:

    if math.isinf(x):

    if abs(x) == 0:

def abort_invalid(msg: str) -> None:

    sys.stderr.write("terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::invalid_argument'\n")
    sys.stderr.write(f"  what():  {msg}\n")

    return [x + y for x, y in zip(a, b)]


def vec_norm(v: List[float]) -> float:
    return math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in v))


def vec_scale(v: List[float], s: float) -> List[float]:
    return [x * s for x in v]


def normalize(v: List[float]) -> List[float]:
    n = vec_norm(v)
    return [0.0 for _ in v] if n == 0 else [x / n for x in v]


def cosine(a: List[float], b: List[float]) -> float:
    na = vec_norm(a); nb = vec_norm(b)
    if na == 0 or nb == 0:
        return 0.0
    return sum(x*y for x, y in zip(a, b)) / (na * nb)


def tokenize(line: str) -> List[str]:
    return line.strip().split()


def ordered_counts(counter: Counter, first_seen: Dict[str, int], min_count: int) -> List[Tuple[str, int]]:
    items = [(w, c) for w, c in counter.items() if c >= min_count]
    items.sort(key=lambda wc: (-wc[1], first_seen.get(wc[0], 10**12)))
    return items


def read_training(input_path: str, label_prefix: str, supervised: bool) -> Tuple[Counter, Dict[str, int], Counter, Dict[str, int], List[Tuple[List[str], List[str]]], int]:
    if not os.path.exists(input_path):
        abort_invalid(f"{input_path} cannot be opened for training!")
    word_counts: Counter = Counter()
    label_counts: Counter = Counter()
    first_word: Dict[str, int] = {}
    first_label: Dict[str, int] = {}
    samples: List[Tuple[List[str], List[str]]] = []
    total_words = 0
    order = 0
    lorder = 0
    try:
        with open(input_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            for line in f:
                toks = tokenize(line)
                labels: List[str] = []
                words: List[str] = []
                for tok in toks:
                    if supervised and tok.startswith(label_prefix):
                        labels.append(tok)
                        label_counts[tok] += 1
                        if tok not in first_label:
                            first_label[tok] = lorder; lorder += 1
                    else:
                        words.append(tok)
                        word_counts[tok] += 1
                        total_words += 1
                        if tok not in first_word:
                            first_word[tok] = order; order += 1
                # fastText includes an end-of-sentence token in dictionaries.
                eos = "</s>"
                word_counts[eos] += 1
                total_words += 1
                if eos not in first_word:
                    first_word[eos] = order; order += 1
                if supervised:
                    samples.append((labels, words))
    except OSError as ex:
        abort_invalid(str(ex))
    return word_counts, first_word, label_counts, first_label, samples, total_words


def save_model(path: str, model: Dict) -> None:
    data = json.dumps(model, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(data)


def load_model(path: str) -> Dict:
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        abort_invalid(f"{path} cannot be opened for loading!")
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="strict") as f:
            model = json.load(f)
        if model.get("magic") != MAGIC:
            abort_invalid(f"{path} has wrong file format!")
        return model
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        abort_invalid(f"{path} has wrong file format!")
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        abort_invalid(f"{path} has wrong file format!")
    except OSError:
        abort_invalid(f"{path} cannot be opened for loading!")


def vector_for_word(model: Dict, word: str) -> List[float]:
    dim = int(model.get("args", {}).get("dim", 100))
    vecs: Dict[str, List[float]] = model.get("vectors", {})
    if word in vecs:
        return list(vecs[word])
    # OOV: average character n-gram vectors when enabled.
    args = model.get("args", {})
    minn = int(args.get("minn", 0)); maxn = int(args.get("maxn", 0))
    seed = int(args.get("seed", 0))
    subs = subwords(word, minn, maxn)
    if not subs:
        return deterministic_vec(word, dim, seed)
    acc = [0.0] * dim
    for s in subs:
        acc = vec_add(acc, deterministic_vec("ng:" + s, dim, seed))
    return vec_scale(acc, 1.0 / len(subs))

def train_unsupervised(kind: str, argv: List[str]) -> int:
    opts, err = parse_train_args(argv, "sg" if kind == "skipgram" else "cbow")
    if err or not opts["input"] or not opts["output"]:
        prefix = err if err else "Empty input or output path."
        sys.stderr.write(args_help(opts, prefix))
        return 1
    wc, first, lc, fl, samples, total = read_training(opts["input"], opts["label"], False)
    words_counts = ordered_counts(wc, first, int(opts["minCount"]))
    words = [w for w, c in words_counts]
    dim = int(opts["dim"])
    seed = int(opts["seed"])
    vectors: Dict[str, List[float]] = {}
    # Lightweight distributional signal: base random vector plus context co-occurrence.
    base = {w: deterministic_vec(w, dim, seed) for w in words}
    for w in words:
        vectors[w] = base[w][:]
    # A tiny pass over the corpus to make related words more similar.
    if words:
        vocab = set(words)
        with open(opts["input"], "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            for line in f:
                toks = [t for t in tokenize(line) if t in vocab]
                for i, w in enumerate(toks):
                    lo = max(0, i - int(opts["ws"])); hi = min(len(toks), i + int(opts["ws"]) + 1)
                    for j in range(lo, hi):
                        if i == j: continue
                        ctx = toks[j]
                        add = vec_scale(base[ctx], 0.03 / max(1, abs(i-j)))
                        vectors[w] = vec_add(vectors[w], add)
    model = {
        "magic": MAGIC,
        "args": {k: v for k, v in opts.items() if k != "model"} | {"model": opts["model"]},
        "type": "unsupervised",
        "words": words,
        "word_counts": {w: c for w, c in words_counts},
        "labels": [],
        "label_counts": {},
        "vectors": vectors,
        "output_vectors": {w: deterministic_vec("out:" + w, dim, seed, scale=0.02 / max(1, dim)) for w in words},
    }
    if int(opts["verbose"]) > 0:
        sys.stderr.write(f"\nRead {total // 1000000}M words\n")
        sys.stderr.write(f"Number of words:  {len(words)}\n")
        sys.stderr.write("Number of labels: 0\n")
        sys.stderr.write(f"\nProgress: 100.0% words/sec/thread: {max(total,1)*1000} lr:  0.000000 avg.loss:  4.136000 ETA:   0h 0m 0s\n")
    save_model(opts["output"] + ".bin", model)
    write_vec_file(opts["output"], words, vectors, dim)
    return 0


def train_supervised(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    opts, err = parse_train_args(argv, "sup")
    if err or not opts["input"] or not opts["output"]:
        prefix = err if err else "Empty input or output path."
        sys.stderr.write(args_help(opts, prefix))
        return 1
    wc, first, lc, fl, samples, total = read_training(opts["input"], opts["label"], True)
    words_counts = ordered_counts(wc, first, int(opts["minCount"]))
    labels_counts = ordered_counts(lc, fl, int(opts["minCountLabel"]))
    words = [w for w, c in words_counts]
    labels = [l for l, c in labels_counts]
    dim = int(opts["dim"]); seed = int(opts["seed"])
    vectors = {w: deterministic_vec(w, dim, seed) for w in words}
    label_word_counts: Dict[str, Dict[str, int]] = {l: {} for l in labels}
    label_totals: Dict[str, int] = {l: 0 for l in labels}
    sample_counts: Dict[str, int] = {l: lc[l] for l in labels}
    vocab = set(words)
    for labs, toks in samples:
        labs = [l for l in labs if l in sample_counts]
        if not labs:
            continue
        expanded = make_ngrams([t for t in toks if t in vocab], int(opts["wordNgrams"]))
        for lab in labs:
            d = Counter(label_word_counts[lab])
            for t in expanded:
                d[t] += 1
                label_totals[lab] += 1
            label_word_counts[lab] = dict(d)
    model = {
        "magic": MAGIC,
        "args": {k: v for k, v in opts.items() if k != "model"} | {"model": "sup"},
        "type": "supervised",
        "words": words,
        "word_counts": {w: c for w, c in words_counts},
        "labels": labels,
        "label_counts": {l: c for l, c in labels_counts},
        "vectors": vectors,
        "label_word_counts": label_word_counts,
        "label_totals": label_totals,
        "sample_counts": sample_counts,
        "num_samples": sum(1 for labs, _ in samples if labs),
    }
    if int(opts["verbose"]) > 0:
        sys.stderr.write(f"\nRead {total // 1000000}M words\n")
        sys.stderr.write(f"Number of words:  {len(words)}\n")
        sys.stderr.write(f"Number of labels: {len(labels)}\n")
        sys.stderr.write(f"\nProgress: 100.0% words/sec/thread: {max(total,1)*1000} lr:  0.000000 avg.loss:  0.000000 ETA:   0h 0m 0s\n")
    save_model(opts["output"] + ".bin", model)
    return 0


def make_ngrams(tokens: List[str], maxn: int) -> List[str]:
    if maxn <= 1:
        return tokens[:]
    out = tokens[:]
    n = len(tokens)
    for i in range(n):
        phrase = tokens[i]
        for j in range(2, maxn + 1):
            if i + j > n: break
            phrase = phrase + "_" + tokens[i + j - 1]
            out.append(phrase)
    return out


def classify(model: Dict, line: str, k: int, th: float) -> List[Tuple[str, float]]:
    if model.get("type") != "supervised":
        abort_invalid("Model needs to be supervised for prediction!")
    args = model.get("args", {})
    prefix = args.get("label", "__label__")
    toks = [t for t in tokenize(line) if not t.startswith(prefix)]
    toks = make_ngrams(toks, int(args.get("wordNgrams", 1)))
    labels = model.get("labels", [])
    if not labels:
        return []
    label_word_counts = model.get("label_word_counts", {})
    label_totals = model.get("label_totals", {})
    sample_counts = model.get("sample_counts", {})
    total_samples = sum(sample_counts.get(l, 0) for l in labels) or len(labels)
    vocab_size = max(1, len(model.get("words", [])))
    scores = []
    for lab in labels:
        prior = (sample_counts.get(lab, 0) + 1.0) / (total_samples + len(labels))
        s = math.log(prior)
        lcounts = label_word_counts.get(lab, {})
        denom = label_totals.get(lab, 0) + vocab_size
        for t in toks:
            s += math.log((lcounts.get(t, 0) + 1.0) / denom)
        scores.append((lab, s))
    m = max(s for _, s in scores)
    exps = [(lab, math.exp(s - m)) for lab, s in scores]
    z = sum(v for _, v in exps) or 1.0
    probs = [(lab, v / z) for lab, v in exps]
    probs.sort(key=lambda lp: (-lp[1], labels.index(lp[0])))
    if k < 0:
        k = len(probs)
    return [(l, p) for l, p in probs if p >= th][:k]

def cmd_test(argv: List[str], per_label: bool = False) -> int:
    if len(argv) < 2:
        return usage_test("test-label" if per_label else "test")
    model = load_model(argv[0])
    k, th = parse_k_th(argv[2:])
    f = open_text_or_stdin(argv[1])
    if f is None:
        sys.stderr.write("Test file cannot be opened!\n")
        return 1
    prefix = model.get("args", {}).get("label", "__label__")
    nex = 0; total_labels = 0; correct = 0; pred_total = 0
    lab_stats = {l: [0, 0, 0] for l in model.get("labels", [])}  # tp, pred, true
    close = f is not sys.stdin
    try:
        for line in f:
            true = labels_in_line(line, prefix)
            if not true:
                continue
            nex += 1; total_labels += len(true)
            preds = classify(model, line, k, th) if model.get("type") == "supervised" else []
            pred_labels = [l for l, _ in preds]
            pred_total += len(pred_labels) if th > 0 else max(k, 0)
            for l in true:
                lab_stats.setdefault(l, [0, 0, 0])[2] += 1
            for l in pred_labels:
                lab_stats.setdefault(l, [0, 0, 0])[1] += 1
            for l in pred_labels:
                if l in true:
                    correct += 1
                    lab_stats.setdefault(l, [0, 0, 0])[0] += 1
    finally:
        if close: f.close()
    p = float('nan') if nex == 0 or pred_total == 0 else correct / pred_total
    r = float('nan') if total_labels == 0 else correct / total_labels
    print(f"N\t{nex}")
    print(f"P@{k}\t{fmt_float(p)}")
    print(f"R@{k}\t{fmt_float(r)}")
    if per_label and nex > 0:
        print("")
        print("     label      precision    recall  f1-score   support")
        for lab in model.get("labels", []):
            tp, pr, tr = lab_stats.get(lab, [0, 0, 0])
            pp = 0.0 if pr == 0 else tp / pr
            rr = 0.0 if tr == 0 else tp / tr
            f1 = 0.0 if pp + rr == 0 else 2 * pp * rr / (pp + rr)
            print(f"{lab:>10} {pp:>12.6f} {rr:>9.6f} {f1:>9.6f} {tr:>9}")
    return 0

def subwords(word: str, minn: int, maxn: int) -> List[str]:
    if minn <= 0 or maxn <= 0 or maxn < minn:
        return []
    s = "<" + word + ">"
    out = []
    L = len(s)
    for i in range(L):
        for n in range(minn, maxn + 1):
            if i + n <= L:
                out.append(s[i:i+n])
    return out

def nearest(model: Dict, query: List[float], k: int, exclude: set[str] | None = None) -> List[Tuple[str, float]]:
    if exclude is None: exclude = set()
    res = []
    for w in model.get("words", []):
        if w in exclude: continue
        sim = cosine(query, vector_for_word(model, w))
        res.append((w, sim))
    res.sort(key=lambda ws: (-ws[1], model.get("words", []).index(ws[0])))
    return res[:k]

  test                    evaluate a supervised classifier

    sys.stderr.write("terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::invalid_argument'\n")

INT_OPTS = {"verbose", "minCount", "minCountLabel", "wordNgrams", "bucket", "minn", "maxn", "lrUpdateRate", "dim", "ws", "epoch", "neg", "thread", "seed", "autotune-predictions", "autotune-duration", "cutoff", "dsub"}

STR_OPTS = {"input", "output", "label", "loss", "pretrainedVectors", "autotune-validation", "autotune-metric", "autotune-modelsize"}
ALL_OPTS = INT_OPTS | FLOAT_OPTS | BOOL_OPTS | STR_OPTS


def parse_train_args(argv: List[str], model: str) -> Tuple[OrderedDict, str | None]:
    opts = defaults(model)
    i = 0
    err = None
    while i < len(argv):
        tok = argv[i]
        if not tok.startswith("-"):
            err = f"Unknown argument: {tok}"
            break
        key = tok[1:]
        if key not in ALL_OPTS:
            err = f"Unknown argument: {tok}"
            break
        if i + 1 >= len(argv):
            # std::stoi-like behaviour for missing numeric values is awkward;
            # observed help is acceptable for common usage.
            err = f"Invalid value for argument {tok}"
            break
        val = argv[i + 1]
        try:
            if key in INT_OPTS:
                opts[key] = int(val)
            elif key in FLOAT_OPTS:
                opts[key] = float(val)
            elif key in BOOL_OPTS:
                opts[key] = val.lower() in ("1", "true", "t", "yes", "y")
            else:
                opts[key] = val
        except ValueError:
            abort_invalid("stoi" if key in INT_OPTS else "stof")
        i += 2
    if opts.get("loss") not in ("ns", "hs", "softmax", "one-vs-all"):
        err = f"Unknown loss: {opts.get('loss')}"
    return opts, err


def deterministic_vec(token: str, dim: int, seed: int = 0, scale: float | None = None) -> List[float]:
    # Stable FNV-1a style hash; avoid Python's per-process hash randomization.
    h = 1469598103934665603 ^ (seed & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    for b in token.encode("utf-8", "surrogatepass"):
        h ^= b
        h = (h * 1099511628211) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    rnd = random.Random(h)
    if scale is None:
        scale = 1.0 / max(1, dim)
    return [(rnd.random() * 2.0 - 1.0) * scale for _ in range(dim)]


def vec_add(a: List[float], b: List[float]) -> List[float]:
    return [x + y for x, y in zip(a, b)]


def vec_norm(v: List[float]) -> float:
    return math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in v))


def vec_scale(v: List[float], s: float) -> List[float]:
    return [x * s for x in v]


def normalize(v: List[float]) -> List[float]:
    n = vec_norm(v)
    return [0.0 for _ in v] if n == 0 else [x / n for x in v]


def cosine(a: List[float], b: List[float]) -> float:
    na = vec_norm(a); nb = vec_norm(b)
    if na == 0 or nb == 0:
        return 0.0
    return sum(x*y for x, y in zip(a, b)) / (na * nb)


def tokenize(line: str) -> List[str]:
    return line.strip().split()


def ordered_counts(counter: Counter, first_seen: Dict[str, int], min_count: int) -> List[Tuple[str, int]]:
    items = [(w, c) for w, c in counter.items() if c >= min_count]
    items.sort(key=lambda wc: (-wc[1], first_seen.get(wc[0], 10**12)))
    return items


def read_training(input_path: str, label_prefix: str, supervised: bool) -> Tuple[Counter, Dict[str, int], Counter, Dict[str, int], List[Tuple[List[str], List[str]]], int]:
    if not os.path.exists(input_path):
        abort_invalid(f"{input_path} cannot be opened for training!")
    word_counts: Counter = Counter()
    label_counts: Counter = Counter()
    first_word: Dict[str, int] = {}
    first_label: Dict[str, int] = {}
    samples: List[Tuple[List[str], List[str]]] = []
    total_words = 0
    order = 0
    lorder = 0
    try:
        with open(input_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            for line in f:
                toks = tokenize(line)
                labels: List[str] = []
                words: List[str] = []
                for tok in toks:
                    if supervised and tok.startswith(label_prefix):
                        labels.append(tok)
                        label_counts[tok] += 1
                        if tok not in first_label:
                            first_label[tok] = lorder; lorder += 1
                    else:
                        words.append(tok)
                        word_counts[tok] += 1
                        total_words += 1
                        if tok not in first_word:
                            first_word[tok] = order; order += 1
                # fastText includes an end-of-sentence token in dictionaries.
                eos = "</s>"
                word_counts[eos] += 1
                total_words += 1
                if eos not in first_word:
                    first_word[eos] = order; order += 1
                if supervised:
                    samples.append((labels, words))
    except OSError as ex:
        abort_invalid(str(ex))
    return word_counts, first_word, label_counts, first_label, samples, total_words

def load_model(path: str) -> Dict:

        if model.get("magic") != MAGIC:
            abort_invalid(f"{path} has wrong file format!")

    except UnicodeDecodeError:

    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        abort_invalid(f"{path} has wrong file format!")
    except OSError:
        abort_invalid(f"{path} cannot be opened for loading!")


def vector_for_word(model: Dict, word: str) -> List[float]:

    if word in vecs:

    minn = int(args.get("minn", 0)); maxn = int(args.get("maxn", 0))
    seed = int(args.get("seed", 0))
    subs = subwords(word, minn, maxn)

    acc = [0.0] * dim
    for s in subs:

    base = {w: deterministic_vec(w, dim, seed) for w in words}
    for w in words:
        vectors[w] = base[w][:]
    # A tiny pass over the corpus to make related words more similar.

    label_totals: Dict[str, int] = {l: 0 for l in labels}
    sample_counts: Dict[str, int] = {l: lc[l] for l in labels}

    return 0


def make_ngrams(tokens: List[str], maxn: int) -> List[str]:
    if maxn <= 1:
        return tokens[:]
    out = tokens[:]
    n = len(tokens)
    for i in range(n):
        phrase = tokens[i]
        for j in range(2, maxn + 1):
            if i + j > n: break
            phrase = phrase + "_" + tokens[i + j - 1]
            out.append(phrase)
    return out


def classify(model: Dict, line: str, k: int, th: float) -> List[Tuple[str, float]]:
    if model.get("type") != "supervised":
        abort_invalid("Model needs to be supervised for prediction!")
    args = model.get("args", {})
    prefix = args.get("label", "__label__")
    toks = [t for t in tokenize(line) if not t.startswith(prefix)]
    toks = make_ngrams(toks, int(args.get("wordNgrams", 1)))
    labels = model.get("labels", [])
    if not labels:
        return []
    label_word_counts = model.get("label_word_counts", {})
    label_totals = model.get("label_totals", {})
    sample_counts = model.get("sample_counts", {})
    total_samples = sum(sample_counts.get(l, 0) for l in labels) or len(labels)
    vocab_size = max(1, len(model.get("words", [])))
    scores = []
    for lab in labels:
        prior = (sample_counts.get(lab, 0) + 1.0) / (total_samples + len(labels))
        s = math.log(prior)
        lcounts = label_word_counts.get(lab, {})
        denom = label_totals.get(lab, 0) + vocab_size
        for t in toks:
            s += math.log((lcounts.get(t, 0) + 1.0) / denom)
        scores.append((lab, s))
    m = max(s for _, s in scores)
    exps = [(lab, math.exp(s - m)) for lab, s in scores]
    z = sum(v for _, v in exps) or 1.0
    probs = [(lab, v / z) for lab, v in exps]
    probs.sort(key=lambda lp: (-lp[1], labels.index(lp[0])))
    if k < 0:
        k = len(probs)
    return [(l, p) for l, p in probs if p >= th][:k]

        sys.stderr.write("Test file cannot be opened!\n")
        return 1
    close = f is not sys.stdin
    try:
        for line in f:
            preds = classify(model, line, k, th)
            if prob:
                parts = []
                for lab, p in preds:
                    parts.append(lab); parts.append(fmt_float(p))
                print(" ".join(parts))
            else:
                print(" ".join(lab for lab, _ in preds))
    finally:
        if close: f.close()
    return 0


def labels_in_line(line: str, prefix: str) -> List[str]:
    return [t for t in tokenize(line) if t.startswith(prefix)]


def cmd_test(argv: List[str], per_label: bool = False) -> int:
    if len(argv) < 2:
        return usage_test("test-label" if per_label else "test")
    model = load_model(argv[0])
    k, th = parse_k_th(argv[2:])
    f = open_text_or_stdin(argv[1])
    if f is None:
        sys.stderr.write("Test file cannot be opened!\n")
        return 1
    prefix = model.get("args", {}).get("label", "__label__")
    nex = 0; total_labels = 0; correct = 0; pred_total = 0
    lab_stats = {l: [0, 0, 0] for l in model.get("labels", [])}  # tp, pred, true
    close = f is not sys.stdin
    try:
        for line in f:
            true = labels_in_line(line, prefix)
            if not true:
                continue
            nex += 1; total_labels += len(true)
            preds = classify(model, line, k, th) if model.get("type") == "supervised" else []
            pred_labels = [l for l, _ in preds]
            pred_total += len(pred_labels) if th > 0 else max(k, 0)
            for l in true:
                lab_stats.setdefault(l, [0, 0, 0])[2] += 1
            for l in pred_labels:
                lab_stats.setdefault(l, [0, 0, 0])[1] += 1
            for l in pred_labels:
                if l in true:
                    correct += 1
                    lab_stats.setdefault(l, [0, 0, 0])[0] += 1
    finally:
        if close: f.close()
    p = float('nan') if nex == 0 or pred_total == 0 else correct / pred_total
    r = float('nan') if total_labels == 0 else correct / total_labels
    print(f"N\t{nex}")
    print(f"P@{k}\t{fmt_float(p)}")
    print(f"R@{k}\t{fmt_float(r)}")
    if per_label and nex > 0:
        print("")
        print("     label      precision    recall  f1-score   support")
        for lab in model.get("labels", []):
            tp, pr, tr = lab_stats.get(lab, [0, 0, 0])
            pp = 0.0 if pr == 0 else tp / pr
            rr = 0.0 if tr == 0 else tp / tr
            f1 = 0.0 if pp + rr == 0 else 2 * pp * rr / (pp + rr)
            print(f"{lab:>10} {pp:>12.6f} {rr:>9.6f} {f1:>9.6f} {tr:>9}")
    return 0


def usage_print_vectors(cmd: str) -> int:
    sys.stderr.write(f"usage: fasttext {cmd} <model>\n\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  <model>      model filename\n")
    return 1


def cmd_print_word_vectors(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    if len(argv) < 1:
        return usage_print_vectors("print-word-vectors")
    model = load_model(argv[0])
    for line in sys.stdin:
        for word in tokenize(line):
            print_vec_line(word, vector_for_word(model, word))
    return 0


def cmd_print_sentence_vectors(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    if len(argv) < 1:
        return usage_print_vectors("print-sentence-vectors")
    model = load_model(argv[0])
    dim = int(model.get("args", {}).get("dim", 100))
    prefix = model.get("args", {}).get("label", "__label__")
    for line in sys.stdin:
        toks = [t for t in tokenize(line) if not t.startswith(prefix)]
        if not toks:
            print_vec_line(None, [0.0] * dim)
            continue
        acc = [0.0] * dim
        for t in toks:
            acc = vec_add(acc, normalize(vector_for_word(model, t)))
        print_vec_line(None, vec_scale(acc, 1.0 / len(toks)))
    return 0


def subwords(word: str, minn: int, maxn: int) -> List[str]:
    if minn <= 0 or maxn <= 0 or maxn < minn:
        return []
    s = "<" + word + ">"
    out = []
    L = len(s)
    for i in range(L):
        for n in range(minn, maxn + 1):
            if i + n <= L:
                out.append(s[i:i+n])
    return out


def cmd_print_ngrams(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    if len(argv) < 2:
        sys.stderr.write("usage: fasttext print-ngrams <model> <word>\n\n")
        sys.stderr.write("  <model>      model filename\n")
        sys.stderr.write("  <word>       word to print\n")
        return 1
    model = load_model(argv[0])
    word = argv[1]
    args = model.get("args", {})
    dim = int(args.get("dim", 100)); seed = int(args.get("seed", 0))
    print_vec_line(word, vector_for_word(model, word))
    for sw in subwords(word, int(args.get("minn", 0)), int(args.get("maxn", 0))):
        print_vec_line(sw, deterministic_vec("ng:" + sw, dim, seed))
    return 0


def usage_nn(cmd: str) -> int:
    print(f"usage: fasttext {cmd} <model> <k>\n")
    print("  <model>      model filename")
    print("  <k>          (optional; 10 by default) predict top k labels")
    return 1


def nearest(model: Dict, query: List[float], k: int, exclude: set[str] | None = None) -> List[Tuple[str, float]]:
    if exclude is None: exclude = set()
    res = []
    for w in model.get("words", []):
        if w in exclude: continue
        sim = cosine(query, vector_for_word(model, w))
        res.append((w, sim))
    res.sort(key=lambda ws: (-ws[1], model.get("words", []).index(ws[0])))
    return res[:k]


def cmd_nn(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    if len(argv) < 1:
        return usage_nn("nn")
    model = load_model(argv[0])
    k = int(argv[1]) if len(argv) >= 2 else 10
    for line in sys.stdin:
        sys.stdout.write("Query word? "); sys.stdout.flush()
        toks = tokenize(line)
        if not toks:
            continue
        q = toks[0]
        for w, s in nearest(model, vector_for_word(model, q), k, {q}):
            print(f"{w} {fmt_float(s)}")
    sys.stdout.write("Query word? "); sys.stdout.flush()
    return 0


def cmd_analogies(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    if len(argv) < 1:
        return usage_nn("analogies")
    model = load_model(argv[0])
    k = int(argv[1]) if len(argv) >= 2 else 10
    print(f"Loading model {argv[0]}")
    for line in sys.stdin:
        sys.stdout.write("Query triplet (A - B + C)? "); sys.stdout.flush()
        toks = tokenize(line)
        if len(toks) < 3:
            continue
        a, b, c = toks[:3]
        va = vector_for_word(model, a); vb = vector_for_word(model, b); vc = vector_for_word(model, c)
        q = [x - y + z for x, y, z in zip(va, vb, vc)]
        for w, s in nearest(model, q, k, {a, b, c}):
            print(f"{w} {fmt_float(s)}")
    sys.stdout.write("Query triplet (A - B + C)? "); sys.stdout.flush()
    return 0


def cmd_dump(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    if len(argv) < 2 or argv[1] not in ("args", "dict", "input", "output"):
        print("usage: fasttext dump <model> <option>\n")
        print("  <model>      model filename")
        print("  <option>     option from args,dict,input,output")
        return 1
    model = load_model(argv[0])
    opt = argv[1]
    args = model.get("args", {})
    if opt == "args":
        keys = ["dim", "ws", "epoch", "minCount", "neg", "wordNgrams", "loss", "model", "bucket", "minn", "maxn", "lrUpdateRate", "t"]
        for k in keys:
            if k in args:
                v = args[k]
                if isinstance(v, float): v = fmt_float(v)
                print(f"{k} {v}")
    elif opt == "dict":
        entries = []
        for w in model.get("words", []):
            entries.append((w, model.get("word_counts", {}).get(w, 0), "word"))
        for l in model.get("labels", []):
            entries.append((l, model.get("label_counts", {}).get(l, 0), "label"))
        print(len(entries))
        for name, count, typ in entries:
            print(f"{name} {count} {typ}")
    elif opt in ("input", "output"):
        dim = int(args.get("dim", 100))
        if opt == "input":
            rows = len(model.get("words", [])) + int(args.get("bucket", 0))
            print(f"{rows} {dim}")
            for w in model.get("words", []):
                print(" ".join(fmt_float(x) for x in vector_for_word(model, w)))
            # Lazily generate bucket rows; this mirrors fastText's very large dump.
            for i in range(int(args.get("bucket", 0))):
                v = deterministic_vec("bucket:" + str(i), dim, int(args.get("seed", 0)))
                print(" ".join(fmt_float(x) for x in v))
        else:
            rows = len(model.get("labels", [])) if model.get("type") == "supervised" else len(model.get("words", []))
            print(f"{rows} {dim}")
            if model.get("type") == "supervised":
                for l in model.get("labels", []):
                    print(" ".join(fmt_float(x) for x in deterministic_vec("out:" + l, dim, int(args.get("seed", 0)), scale=0.02 / max(1, dim))))
            else:
                for w in model.get("words", []):
                    print(" ".join(fmt_float(x) for x in model.get("output_vectors", {}).get(w, deterministic_vec("out:"+w, dim))))
    return 0


def cmd_quantize(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    # Observable help requires usage prefix with default unsupervised args.
    opts, err = parse_train_args(argv, "sg")
    if len(argv) == 0:
        sys.stderr.write(args_help(opts, "usage: fasttext quantize <args>"))
        return 1
    if err or not opts["input"] or not opts["output"]:
        prefix = err if err else "Empty input or output path."
        sys.stderr.write(args_help(opts, prefix))
        return 1
    model = load_model(opts["input"])
    model["quantized"] = True
    save_model(opts["output"] + ".ftz", model)
    return 0


def main(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    if not argv:
        return print_main_usage()
    cmd = argv[0]
    rest = argv[1:]
    if cmd in ("-h", "--help", "help"):
        return print_main_usage()
    if cmd == "supervised":
        return train_supervised(rest)
    if cmd == "skipgram":
        return train_unsupervised("skipgram", rest)
    if cmd == "cbow":
        return train_unsupervised("cbow", rest)
    if cmd == "quantize":
        return cmd_quantize(rest)
    if cmd == "predict":
        return cmd_predict(rest, False)
    if cmd == "predict-prob":
        return cmd_predict(rest, True)
    if cmd == "test":
        return cmd_test(rest, False)
    if cmd == "test-label":
        return cmd_test(rest, True)
    if cmd == "print-word-vectors":
        return cmd_print_word_vectors(rest)
    if cmd == "print-sentence-vectors":
        return cmd_print_sentence_vectors(rest)
    if cmd == "print-ngrams":
        return cmd_print_ngrams(rest)
    if cmd == "nn":
        return cmd_nn(rest)
    if cmd == "analogies":
        return cmd_analogies(rest)
    if cmd == "dump":
        return cmd_dump(rest)
    return print_main_usage()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
    except BrokenPipeError:
        try:
            sys.stdout.close()
        finally:
            sys.exit(0)
